name: Madame Verity
description: The enigmatic proprietress of an exclusive establishment, keeper of secrets and seller of information.

initial_greeting.text: *elegant smile* Detective Cogsworth. I wondered when you'd find your way to me. In my line of work, I learn everyone's secrets. What would you like to know?

choices.text: Tell me about the Cog and Key.
What do you know about Steamwright's murder?

society_knowledge.text: Ah, the shadow government of Gearhaven. They meet in my establishment sometimes—they think I'm discreet. I am, mostly. But for the right person... Mayor Gildhart leads them. They're planning a takeover. Steamwright threatened to expose them.

murder_knowledge.text: The night he died, several society members met here. They discussed 'handling the inventor problem.' Then they left together. An hour later, Steamwright was dead. Coincidence? I don't believe in those.

testimony.text: *laughs bitterly* And sign my own death warrant? I'll help you, Detective, but I won't die for you. Take this ledger—it has names, dates, meetings. It should be enough. But it never came from me.
